This service unit can be located at the Integrated Service Center (PPT) and Integrated Crisis Center (PKT) based in Hospitals, Community Health Centers, Integrated Service Center for Women and Child Empowerment (P2TP2A), Women and Children Service Unit (UPPA), Trauma Center Shelter (RPTC), Children's Social Shelter (RPSA), BP4, and other religious institutions, prosecutor's offices, courts, Women Crisis Center (WCC), and other similar institutions. 4.2.evidence:
Article 28
Paragraph (1) Sufficiently clear.
Paragraph (2) Point a What is meant by "network" includes: family partners, dasawisma, family groups that exist in the Region.
Point b What is meant by "coordination" includes: planning, implementation and monitoring of violence prevention programs.
